context: An elderly couple discusses family news
purpose: Teach: 倒し/止まり/乱暴/目線/暴れ/なくす/婚約/ズレ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫の婚約、決まったらしいな。
lines.style: Slow opening pause. Quiet gravity, like turning over something precious in the hand. Steady breath. Words fall with gentle weight. No rush.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ええ、若い頃の私たちと、ズレない巡り合わせよ。
lines.en: Yes. It feels like the right timing—no distance from when we were young.
lines.style: Warm recognition, almost a private smile in the voice. Slight lift on 「ズレない」. Nostalgic but not wistful. Present and certain.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 乱暴な世間でも、二人なら倒し倒され、支え合えるさ。
lines.en: The world's rough, but if it's these two—they'll stumble and catch each other.
lines.style: Dry understanding underneath. Matter-of-fact realism that's not cynical. Slight edge of humor on 「倒し倒され」. Settling into wisdom.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 時間が止まりそうな幸せ、忘れないでね。
lines.en: Don't let yourself forget this—the kind of joy that stops time.
lines.style: Tender directive, not commanding. Soft attack. Almost a whisper of urgency beneath gentleness. Like tucking something fragile into memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 目線が低くて優しい子だから、安心だ。
lines.en: He's got gentle eyes, that boy. That's what reassures me.
lines.style: Observant and approving. Light pause after 「優しい子」. Simple conviction. The confidence of someone who reads people well and doesn't need to elaborate.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 感情が暴れた若い頃、私たちも、ね。
lines.en: We had wild hearts at that age too, didn't we.
lines.style: Knowing softness. Slight laugh in the undercurrent—not judgment, recognition. Traveling back in time with her without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 勢いをなくすことなく、彼らも歩めばいい。
lines.en: They should walk on without losing that fire.
lines.style: Benediction. Calm finality. Words land like a gentle settle. Quiet conviction wrapped in blessing. No performance—just truth stated simply.
